        Muted = Color3.fromRGB(85, 90, 100),
        Accent = Color3.fromRGB(95, 50, 255)
    }
}

local function getTheme()
    if currentTheme == "White" then
        return themes.White
    end

    local theme = {}

    for key, value in pairs(themes.Black) do
        theme[key] = value
    end

    if currentTheme == "Custom" then
        theme.Accent = customColor
        theme.Main = customColor:Lerp(Color3.fromRGB(8, 8, 12), 0.78)
        theme.Panel = customColor:Lerp(Color3.fromRGB(28, 28, 35), 0.72)
        theme.Control = customColor:Lerp(Color3.fromRGB(42, 42, 50), 0.68)
        theme.DarkPanel = customColor:Lerp(Color3.fromRGB(18, 18, 24), 0.75)
        theme.Text = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
        theme.Muted = Color3.fromRGB(215, 215, 225)
    end

    return theme
end

local function getAccent()
    if currentTheme == "Rainbow" then
        return Color3.fromHSV((tick() * 0.35) % 1, 0.8, 1)
    end

    return getTheme().Accent
end

local function setInvisible(state)
    local character = player.Character

    if not character then
        return
    end

    invisible = state

    for _, object in ipairs(character:GetDescendants()) do
        if object:IsA("BasePart") then
            if object.Name ~= "HumanoidRootPart" then
                object.LocalTransparencyModifier = invisible and 1 or 0
            end
        elseif object:IsA("Decal") then
            object.Transparency = invisible and 1 or 0
        end
    end

    setButtonState(
        invisibleButton,
        invisible,
        "Invisible: ON",
        "Invisible: OFF"
    )
end

local function enableNoclip()
    local character = player.Character

    if not character then
        return
    end

    for _, object in ipairs(character:GetDescendants()) do
        if object:IsA("BasePart") then
            if originalCollisions[object] == nil then
                originalCollisions[object] = object.CanCollide
            end

            object.CanCollide = false
        end
    end
end

local function disableNoclip()
    for object, state in pairs(originalCollisions) do
        if object and object.Parent then
            object.CanCollide = state
        end
    end

    originalCollisions = {}
end

local function getFOVCenter()
    if fovMode == "Crosshair" then
        local size = camera.ViewportSize
        return Vector2.new(size.X / 2, size.Y / 2)
    else
        local mouse = UIS:GetMouseLocation()
        local inset = GuiService:GetGuiInset()

        return Vector2.new(mouse.X, mouse.Y - inset.Y)
    end
end

local function validTarget(targetPlayer)
    if not targetPlayer
        or targetPlayer == player
        or not targetPlayer.Parent
        or not targetPlayer.Character then
        return false
    end

    local humanoid = targetPlayer.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    local head = targetPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("Head")
    local targetRoot = targetPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    local _, myRoot = getCharacter()

    if not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 or not head then
        return false
    end

    if myRoot
        and targetRoot
        and _G.__EriusAimbotRange then

        local distance =
            (myRoot.Position - targetRoot.Position).Magnitude

        if distance > _G.__EriusAimbotRange.Value then
            return false
        end
    end

    if ignoreNeutral and targetPlayer.Neutral then
        return false
    end

    if ignoreTeam
        and player.Team ~= nil
        and targetPlayer.Team ~= nil
        and targetPlayer.Team == player.Team then
        return false
    end

    if ignoreFriends then
        local ok, isFriend = pcall(function()
            return player:IsFriendsWith(targetPlayer.UserId)
        end)

        if ok and isFriend then
            return false
        end
    end

    return true
end

local function findClosestTarget()
    local center = getFOVCenter()
    local closest = nil
    local closestDistance = fovSize

    for _, targetPlayer in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if validTarget(targetPlayer) then
            local head = targetPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("Head")

            if head then
                local screenPos, onScreen =
                    camera:WorldToViewportPoint(head.Position)

                if onScreen then
                    local distance =
                        (Vector2.new(screenPos.X, screenPos.Y) - center).Magnitude

                    if distance < closestDistance then
                        closestDistance = distance
                        closest = targetPlayer
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end

    return closest
end

    local cameraNow = workspace.CurrentCamera

    if not cameraNow then
        return
    end

    local viewport = cameraNow.ViewportSize
    local gap = 14

    local hubX = main.AbsolutePosition.X
    local hubY = main.AbsolutePosition.Y
    local hubW = main.AbsoluteSize.X

    local clickerW =
        clickerMinimized
        and 150
        or 320

    local clickerH =
        clickerMinimized
        and 75
        or 375

    local rightX = hubX + hubW + gap
    local leftX = hubX - clickerW - gap

    local targetX

    if rightX + clickerW <= viewport.X - 8 then
        targetX = rightX
    elseif leftX >= 8 then
        targetX = leftX
    else
        if (viewport.X - (hubX + hubW)) >= hubX then
            targetX =
                math.clamp(
                    rightX,
                    8,
                    math.max(8, viewport.X - clickerW - 8)
                )
        else
            targetX =
                math.clamp(
                    leftX,
                    8,
                    math.max(8, viewport.X - clickerW - 8)
                )
        end
    end

    local targetY =
        math.clamp(
            hubY,
            8,
            math.max(8, viewport.Y - clickerH - 8)
        )

    clickerFrame.Position =
        UDim2.fromOffset(
            targetX,

local function performClickerClick()
    local didClick = false

    pcall(function()
        if type(mouse1click) == "function" then
            mouse1click()
            didClick = true
        elseif type(mouse1press) == "function"
            and type(mouse1release) == "function" then

            mouse1press()
            mouse1release()
            didClick = true
        end
    end)

    if didClick then
        return
    end

    pcall(function()
        local virtualInput = game:GetService("VirtualInputManager")
        local pos = UIS:GetMouseLocation()

        virtualInput:SendMouseButtonEvent(
            pos.X,
            pos.Y,
            0,
            true,
            game,
            0
        )

        virtualInput:SendMouseButtonEvent(
            pos.X,
            pos.Y,
            0,
            false,
            game,
            0
        )
    end)
end

    _G.__EriusBringWindowToFront("Clicker")

    clickerStartPosition = clickerFrame.Position

local function updateClickerDrag(input)
    if not clickerDragging
        or not clickerDragStart
        or not clickerStartPosition then

        return
    end

    local delta =
        input.Position
        -
        clickerDragStart

    if math.abs(delta.X) > 5
        or math.abs(delta.Y) > 5 then

        clickerMoved = true
    end

    clickerFrame.Position =
        UDim2.new(
            clickerStartPosition.X.Scale,
            clickerStartPosition.X.Offset + delta.X,
            clickerStartPosition.Y.Scale,
            clickerStartPosition.Y.Offset + delta.Y
        )
end

_G.__EriusPlaceSteelBesideHub = function()
    local cameraNow = workspace.CurrentCamera

    if not cameraNow then
        return
    end

    local viewport = cameraNow.ViewportSize
    local gap = 14
    local hubX = main.AbsolutePosition.X
    local hubY = main.AbsolutePosition.Y
    local hubW = main.AbsoluteSize.X

    local steelW =
        _G.__EriusSteelMinimized
        and 150
        or 320

    local steelH =
        _G.__EriusSteelMinimized
        and 75
        or 250

    local rightX = hubX + hubW + gap
    local leftX = hubX - steelW - gap
    local targetX

    if rightX + steelW <= viewport.X - 8 then
        targetX = rightX
    elseif leftX >= 8 then
        targetX = leftX
    else
        targetX =
            math.clamp(
                rightX,
                8,
                math.max(8, viewport.X - steelW - 8)
            )
    end

    local targetY =
        math.clamp(
            hubY + 160,
            8,
            math.max(8, viewport.Y - steelH - 8)
        )

    _G.__EriusSteelFrame.Position =
        UDim2.fromOffset(targetX, targetY)
end

    local startX = colorSlider.AbsolutePosition.X
    local width = colorSlider.AbsoluteSize.X

    if width <= 0 then
        return

    local percent =
        math.clamp(
            (x - startX) / width,
            0,
            1
        )

    customColor =
        Color3.fromHSV(

            1

    colorKnob.Position =
        UDim2.new(

            0,
            0.5,
            0

    currentTheme = "Custom"
    applyTheme()
end

task.spawn(function()
    TweenService:Create(
        startupScale,
        TweenInfo.new(
            0.22,
            Enum.EasingStyle.Back,
            Enum.EasingDirection.Out
        ),
        {Scale = 1}
    ):Play()

    TweenService:Create(
        startupLogo,
        TweenInfo.new(
            0.28,
            Enum.EasingStyle.Quint,
            Enum.EasingDirection.Out
        ),
        {ImageTransparency = 0}
    ):Play()

    TweenService:Create(
        startupTitle,
        TweenInfo.new(0.18),
        {TextTransparency = 0}
    ):Play()

    TweenService:Create(
        startupDescription,
        TweenInfo.new(0.18),
        {TextTransparency = 0}
    ):Play()

    local loadingTime = 1.25
    local startTime = tick()

    while running do
        local progress =
            math.clamp(
                (tick() - startTime) / loadingTime,
                0,
                1
            )

        local percent =
            math.floor(
                progress * 100
            )

        startupPercent.Text =
            tostring(percent)
            .. "%"

        startupBar.Size =
            UDim2.fromScale(
                progress,
                1
            )

        if progress >= 1 then
            break
        end

        RunService.RenderStepped:Wait()
    end

    startupPercent.Text = "100%"
    startupBar.Size =
        UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)

    task.wait(0.55)

    TweenService:Create(
        startupFrame,
        TweenInfo.new(
            0.2,
            Enum.EasingStyle.Quint,
            Enum.EasingDirection.In
        ),
        {
            BackgroundTransparency = 1
        }
    ):Play()

    TweenService:Create(
        startupScale,
        TweenInfo.new(
            0.2,
            Enum.EasingStyle.Quint,
            Enum.EasingDirection.In
        ),
        {
            Scale = 1.04
        }
    ):Play()

    for _, object in ipairs(
        startupFrame:GetDescendants()
    ) do
        if object:IsA("TextLabel") then
            TweenService:Create(
                object,
                TweenInfo.new(0.18),
                {
                    TextTransparency = 1
                }
            ):Play()

        elseif object:IsA("ImageLabel") then
            TweenService:Create(
                object,
                TweenInfo.new(0.18),
                {
                    ImageTransparency = 1
                }
            ):Play()

        elseif object:IsA("Frame")
            and object ~= startupFrame then

            TweenService:Create(
                object,
                TweenInfo.new(0.18),
                {
                    BackgroundTransparency = 1
                }
            ):Play()
        end
    end

    task.wait(0.22)

    if startupFrame
        and startupFrame.Parent then

        startupFrame:Destroy()
    end

    startupFinished = true

    tabs.Visible = true
    pages.Visible = true
    credits.Visible = true
    title.Visible = true
    minimize.Visible = true

    if animationsEnabled then
        mainScale.Scale = 0.94

        TweenService:Create(
            mainScale,
            TweenInfo.new(
                0.22,
                Enum.EasingStyle.Back,
                Enum.EasingDirection.Out
            ),
            {
                Scale = hubScale
            }
        ):Play()
    else
        mainScale.Scale = hubScale
    end
end)

    local function hasClearShot(targetPlayer)
        if not targetPlayer or not targetPlayer.Character then
            return false

        local targetHead = targetPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("Head")
        local myCharacter = player.Character

        if not targetHead or not myCharacter then
            return false
        end

        local origin = camera.CFrame.Position
        local direction = targetHead.Position - origin

        if direction.Magnitude <= 0 then
            return false
        end

        local params = RaycastParams.new()
        params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
        params.FilterDescendantsInstances = {myCharacter}
        params.IgnoreWater = true

        local result = workspace:Raycast(origin, direction, params)

        if not result then
            return true
        end

        return result.Instance
            and result.Instance:IsDescendantOf(targetPlayer.Character)
    end

    local function triggerShoot()

                mouse1click()
                return

            virtualInput:SendMouseButtonEvent(
                pos.X,
                pos.Y,
                0,
                true,
                game,
                0

            task.wait(0.02)

            virtualInput:SendMouseButtonEvent(
                pos.X,
                pos.Y,
                0,
                false,

connect(
    RunService.Heartbeat,
    function(dt)
        if not running then
            return
        end

        if clickerOpen
            and clickerEnabled then

            clickerAccumulator =
                clickerAccumulator
                +
                dt

            local interval =
                1
                /
                math.max(
                    clickerCPS,
                    1
                )

            local clicksThisFrame =
                0

            while clickerAccumulator
                >= interval
                and clicksThisFrame < 50 do

                clickerAccumulator =
                    clickerAccumulator
                    -
                    interval

                performClickerClick()

                clicksThisFrame =
                    clicksThisFrame
                    +
                    1
            end
        else
            clickerAccumulator =
                0
        end
    end
)

connect(
    UIS.InputEnded,
    function(input)
        if clickerOpen
            and clickerKey
            and _G.__EriusClickerMode == "Hold"
            and input.KeyCode == clickerKey then

            _G.__EriusClickerKeyHeld = false
            clickerEnabled = false
            clickerAccumulator = 0
            refreshClickerVisual()
        end

        if input.UserInputType
            == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton2 then

            rightMouseHeld = false

            local _, myRoot, myHumanoid =
                getCharacter()

            if _G.__EriusAimLastLook then
                local releaseLook =
                    _G.__EriusAimLastLook

                if myRoot then
                    local characterLook =
                        myRoot.CFrame.LookVector

                    local horizontal =
                        Vector3.new(
                            characterLook.X,
                            0,
                            characterLook.Z
                        )

                    if horizontal.Magnitude > 0.001 then
                        local vertical =
                            math.clamp(
                                releaseLook.Y,
                                -0.98,
                                0.98
                            )

                        local horizontalScale =
                            math.sqrt(
                                math.max(
                                    0.001,
                                    1 - vertical * vertical
                                )
                            )

                        releaseLook =
                            Vector3.new(
                                horizontal.Unit.X * horizontalScale,
                                vertical,
                                horizontal.Unit.Z * horizontalScale
                            ).Unit
                    end
                end

                camera.CFrame =
                    CFrame.lookAt(
                        camera.CFrame.Position,
                        camera.CFrame.Position
                            + releaseLook
                    )

                _G.__EriusAimLastLook =
                    releaseLook
            end

            if myHumanoid then
                if _G.__EriusAimWasAutoRotate ~= nil then
                    myHumanoid.AutoRotate =
                        _G.__EriusAimWasAutoRotate
                else
                    myHumanoid.AutoRotate = true
                end
            end

            _G.__EriusAimWasAutoRotate = nil
            currentTarget = nil
        end

        if input.UserInputType
            == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
            or input.UserInputType
            == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then

            slidingRange = false

            if _G.__EriusAimbotRange then
                _G.__EriusAimbotRange.Sliding = false
            end

            colorSliding = false

            if clickerDragging then
                local source =
                    clickerDragSource

                local wasMoved =
                    clickerMoved

                clickerDragging = false
                clickerDragSource = nil
                clickerDragStart = nil
                clickerStartPosition = nil

                if source == "minimize"
                    and not wasMoved then

                    setClickerMinimized(
                        not clickerMinimized
                    )
                end
            end
        end
    end
)

local function cleanup()
    if not running then
        return
    end

    running = false
    flying = false
    noclip = false
    aimbotEnabled = false
    _G.__EriusInfiniteJump = false
    _G.__EriusInstantInteract = false

    if _G.__EriusRestoreInstantPrompts then
        _G.__EriusRestoreInstantPrompts()
    end

    triggerAimEnabled = false
    triggerAimReadyAt = 0

    clickerEnabled = false
    clickerOpen = false
    _G.__EriusClickerKeyHeld = false
    clickerKey = nil
    waitingForClickerKey = false
    clickerAccumulator = 0

    rightMouseHeld = false
    currentTarget = nil

    local _, root, humanoid =
        getCharacter()

    if root then
        root.AssemblyLinearVelocity =
            Vector3.zero
    end

    if humanoid then
        humanoid.WalkSpeed =
            normalSpeed
    end

    disableNoclip()

    if invisible then
        invisible = false

        local character =
            player.Character

        if character then
            for _, object in ipairs(
                character:GetDescendants()
            ) do
                if object:IsA("BasePart") then
                    object.LocalTransparencyModifier =
                        0
                elseif object:IsA("Decal") then
                    object.Transparency =
                        0
                end
            end
        end
    end

    clearAllESP()

    if blur then
        blur:Destroy()
    end

    if fovCircle then
        fovCircle:Destroy()
    end

    for _, connection in ipairs(
        connections
    ) do
        pcall(function()
            connection:Disconnect()
        end)
    end

    table.clear(connections)

    if gui then
        gui:Destroy()
    end
end

-- DRAG
--------------------------------------------------

local dragging = false
local dragStart
local startPosition
local moved = false
local dragSource

local function startDrag(input, source)
    _G.__EriusBringWindowToFront("Hub")

    dragging = true
    moved = false
    dragSource = source
    dragStart = input.Position
    startPosition = main.Position
end

local function updateDrag(input)
    if not dragging then
        return
    end

    local delta =
        input.Position
        -
        dragStart

    if math.abs(delta.X) > 5
        or math.abs(delta.Y) > 5 then

        moved = true
    end

    main.Position =
        UDim2.new(
            startPosition.X.Scale,
            startPosition.X.Offset + delta.X,
            startPosition.Y.Scale,
            startPosition.Y.Offset + delta.Y
        )
end

connect(
    minimize.InputBegan,
    function(input)
        if input.UserInputType
            == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
            or input.UserInputType
            == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then

            startDrag(
                input,
                "minimize"
            )
        end
    end
)

connect(
    title.InputBegan,
    function(input)
        if minimized then
            return
        end

        if input.UserInputType
            == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
            or input.UserInputType
            == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then

            startDrag(
                input,
                "title"
            )
        end
    end
)

connect(
    UIS.InputChanged,
    function(input)
        if input.UserInputType
            == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement
            or input.UserInputType
            == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then

            updateDrag(input)

            if _G.__EriusSteelDragging
                and _G.__EriusUpdateSteelDrag then

                _G.__EriusUpdateSteelDrag(input)
            end
        end
    end
)

connect(
    UIS.InputEnded,
    function(input)
        if input.UserInputType
            == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
            or input.UserInputType
            == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then

            if _G.__EriusSteelDragging then
                local steelSource =
                    _G.__EriusSteelDragSource

                local steelMoved =
                    _G.__EriusSteelMoved

                _G.__EriusSteelDragging = false
                _G.__EriusSteelDragSource = nil
                _G.__EriusSteelDragStart = nil
                _G.__EriusSteelStartPosition = nil

                if steelSource == "minimize"
                    and not steelMoved
                    and _G.__EriusSetSteelMinimized then

                    _G.__EriusSetSteelMinimized(
                        not _G.__EriusSteelMinimized
                    )
                end
            end

            if dragging then
                local source =
                    dragSource

                local wasMoved =
                    moved

                dragging = false
                dragSource = nil
                dragStart = nil
                startPosition = nil

                if source
                    == "minimize"
                    and not wasMoved then

                    setMinimized(
                        not minimized
                    )
                end
            end
        end
    end
)
